item.title: Navi 0.3.0（20261121.004809）
item.description:
Ash 改名为 Navi。新版换了应用标识，没法从 Ash 里直接更新：点「了解更多」下载 Navi，拖进「应用程序」后打开一次，它会接过 Navi 的设置、数据和登录项，并把旧的 Ash.app 移到废纸篓。

  • chore(mac): 版本号 0.3.0
  • fix(macos): stage paused retry targets without activating them
  • fix(macos): persist rollback pause and retire recovery test services
  • fix(macos): preserve legacy restart and target new runtime after rollback
  • fix(macos): include recovery identity in established compile sources
  • fix(macos): retain explicit recovery prompt after main merge
  • fix(runtime): share side-effect-free takeover preflight and pause rejected switches
  • feat(macos): integrate safe runtime handover and durable agent channels
  • fix(macos): recover unused gateways with damaged records
  • fix(macos): fence stable gateway identity writers
  • fix(macos): recover gateway faults and retire verified idle channels
  • chore(runtime): retain latest accepted main web changes
  • fix(macos): recover and version stable agent channels
  • fix(web): show actual send conditions in collapsed message tray
  • chore(runtime): align integration tree with accepted main 4b74da3a7
  • fix(macos): preserve agent channels across runtime handoff
  • fix(macos): add explicit recovery for blocked runtime switches
  • fix(macos): protect agent relay and hook channels during runtime handoff
  • fix(macos): isolate per-task runtime eligibility failures
  • fix(macos): harden runtime handoff recovery and stable MCP entry
  • fix(runtime): reject partial workspace holds during service handover
  • fix: preserve independent forks from archived tasks
  • feat(macos): preserve running tasks across versioned runtime updates
  • test(mac): initialize detached completion fixture before host imports
  • fix(mac): base idle shutdown on owned cleanup resources
  • fix(mac): handle legacy migration, defer frozen starts and stabilize MCP entry
  • fix: freeze archived decision cards and derived task creation
  • fix(retry-turn): 依赖旧上下文的输入在选会话那一步收口——续不上就改发完整指令并如实留一句，拿不出完整指令就不起跑（审查第 3 轮 F1/N1）
  • Compare canonical runtime paths in macOS fixture
  • Include Homebrew Node library in isolated runtime fixtures
